bio: Hi, I’m Eriana — your favorite cringe-core trans wolf girl howling through VRChat and beyond 💜I stream virtual chaos, cozy vibes, and LGBTQ+ joy with a side of dark aesthetic and unhinged energy. Expect a wild mix of heartfelt convos, cursed memes, and fashionably feral fits.
